description:
Play The Mirari Conjecture and Capture of Jingzhou, then go to the next turn.
Use Conjecture's 2nd activation to add Capture of Jingzhou back to hand, then play Nesting Grounds.
Play Capture of Jingzhou.
Go to the next turn.
Activate Nesting Grounds to remove a saga counter from Conjecture, then add back Capture of Jingzhou when Conjecture's 2nd activation triggers again.
